Background:
<start of reference>
RELATED

HOLLAND, Mich. (WOOD) — There may be more entrepreneurs soon heading to West Michigan after business experts named Holland the best small city in the nation to start a business.

The tulip-speckled city beat out more than 1,200 other cities to earn the top spot on WalletHub's list, largely due to its access to resources, like investors and higher education assets.

"We're a place that people want to be," City Manager Keith Van Beek told 24 Hour News 8.

He said that support for new businesses is in Holland's "DNA and culture."

"We have a lot of great history and tradition of great ideas that were spawned in garages here that turned into fantastic large companies," Van Beek stated.

Eager entrepreneurs aren't the only people trying to set up shop in Holland.

"We've been trying for about two years to get downtown," said Jake Hogeboom, a broker at @Home Realty. "This was the third or fourth property that we made an offer on."

Hogeboom founded the company in Grand Haven six years ago. Months later, it expanded to the outskirts of Holland. His business outgrew that space and construction will soon wrap up on @Home Realty's new building at the corner of E. 7th Street and College Avenue.

Hogeboom said he's excited to be closer to the downtown energy.

"We love the development, we love what the city's doing (and) what the local developers are doing," he explained.

The company's new downtown location will boast a massive slide, offering transport from the second to first floor. It also features an in-house arcade.

However, the building will be much more than an adult playground. The third floor will transform into a space to support other businesses.

"We'll have 27 offices up there to rent out for smaller local businesses that just need one or two offices, that are looking to grow or start up businesses that can be a part of a building of this capacity but don't have the budget to go and get a big office in this location," Hogeboom explained.

Holland's economic development group, Lakeshore Advantage, seems to have played a big role in its WalletHub ranking. The city's access to investors as well as job growth between 2013 and 2017 helped thrust it to that No. 1 spot.
<end of reference>
Task:
Summarize the main reason why Holland, Michigan is a good place to start a business in at least 5 sentences aimed at high school students.
response_a: Holland, Michigan is an excellent place to start a business because of its supportive community, rich history of entrepreneurship, access to resources such as investors and higher education institutions, and its thriving downtown area with plenty of opportunities for growth and development.
response_b:
Holland, Michigan is an excellent place to start a business due to its thriving entrepreneurial community, abundant resources, and supportive environment. With its rich history of innovation and tradition, the city has become a hub for small businesses and startups. Here are five reasons why Holland is an ideal location for aspiring entrepreneurs:

1. Strong Entrepreneurial Culture: Holland has a strong entrepreneurial culture, with many successful businesses having been founded in the area. This creates a supportive network of like-minded individuals who can provide guidance, mentorship, and collaboration opportunities.
2. Access to Resources: Holland offers a wide range of resources for entrepreneurs, including access to capital, networking events, and business incubators. The city's economic development group, Lakeshore Advantage, plays a crucial role in connecting entrepreneurs with these resources and fostering business growth.
3. Affordable Cost of Living: Holland has an affordable cost of living, making it an attractive destination for entrepreneurs looking to start a business without breaking the bank. The city offers a high quality of life, with beautiful parks, a vibrant arts scene, and a strong sense of community.
4. Skilled Workforce: Holland has a skilled workforce, with many residents possessing the knowledge and expertise necessary to support a diverse range of businesses. The city's educational institutions, such as Hope College and Western Michigan University, also provide a steady stream of talented graduates who are eager to contribute to the local economy.
5. Strategic Location: Holland is located in the heart of the Midwest, making it an ideal location for businesses looking to expand their reach into new markets. The city's proximity to major highways, airports, and railroads facilitates easy transportation of goods and services, while its central time zone makes it convenient for conducting business with clients and partners across the country.

In summary, Holland, Michigan is an excellent place to start a business due to its strong entrepreneurial culture, access to resources, affordable cost of living, skilled workforce, and strategic location. These factors combine to create a supportive and fertile environment for entrepreneurs looking to build successful businesses.
